text:
zoe: Quick follow-up on the routing instability RFC: proposing a small runtime component called the "signal-reconciler" (aka gatekeeper) that lives between probes and the policy engine. Purpose: reduce churn by reconciling conflicting signal slices before eval.

kartik: Nice name. How is this different from the "gate" idea we've talked about?

zoe: Similar intent but different shape: gatekeeper focuses on multi-signal reconciliation and stateful smoothing with explicit hysteresis rather than simple pass/hold. It emits a reconciled view + stability metadata per key (region/model/tier).

emily: Can you list inputs/outputs?

zoe: Inputs: latency probes, fill-rate/capacity samples, price feed, tenant-level overrides. Outputs: reconciled_signals:{latency_ms, capacity_pct, price_adj}, stability_score (0-1), sticky_flag (bool), reason_tags.

kartik: Sounds heavier. Will this add latency?

zoe: Target is microseconds for pure in-process path. Options:
- in-process fast path (stateless EWMA + small ring buffer)
- sidecar with local sync for richer rules (hysteresis counters, cooldown windows)
We default to in-process; switch to sidecar if p95 memory or CPU hit.

emily: What smoothing algo? EWMA alone can be laggy.

zoe: We'll use hybrid: short-window median filter to remove spikes then EWMA for trend. Add hysteresis counter: require N consecutive samples beyond threshold to change sticky_flag. Also implement cooldown: once a region flips, prevent further flips for cool_down_ms.

kartik: How do policies consume this? Do we need DSL changes?

zoe: Minimal DSL change. Current policy sees raw_signals[]. New optional field: reconciled_context which policy can opt into. Example policy_input JSON:
{
  "tenant": "acme",
  "model": "rwd-2b",
  "reconciled_context": {
    "us-east-1": {"latency_ms": 98, "capacity_pct": 0.42, "stability": 0.87, "sticky": false}
  },
  "raw_signals": [...]  
}
Policy compiler: add flag route.use_reconciled_context (default false). Compiler should accept both versions.

emily: Rollout plan?

zoe: Step 0: dark-run in telemetry-only mode for 72h across two regions. Collect divergence metrics vs baseline. Step 1: canary 1% traffic with reconciled_context enabled but policy still prefers raw if stability < 0.5. Step 2: increase to 10% then 25% with sticky hysteresis tuned.

kartik: What telemetry do we emit?

zoe: reconciler.event.{region}.{signal}.{result} with tags: stability_bucket, flip_count, cooldown_remaining_ms. Also reconciler.sample.{stat}. Emit replay_id for every reconciled snapshot.

emily: Debugging: need a simple way to force-eval using reconciler vs raw. Add decision_trace fields: reconciler_id, reconciler_reason, used_reconciled (true|false).

qa-bot: Automated tests suggested: fuzzed probe traces, spike injection, long-tail spike sequences, simulated multi-tenant override conflicts. Add golden-case regression in policy-sim harness.

zoe: Perf targets: reconciler p95 < 1ms in-process, p99 < 5ms. Sidecar target p95 < 3ms. If sidecar used, include local LRU cache to serve short bursts.

kartik: Ownership? Who builds reconciler vs sanitizer plugins?

zoe: I'll own the core reconciler prototype. Emily will own the signal adapters (latency, capacity, price). Kartik will update the compiler. QA owns the test harness. Devops to run dark-run.

devops-bot: Dark-run job queued -> job_id=rr-1798889999-1 region=[us-east-1,us-west-2]

zoe: One more behavioral detail: support "prefer_low_cost" tenant affinity. If tenant opts in, reconciler will bias capacity/price merging to favor cheaper regions when stability_score > 0.7. This preserves tenant policy intent without exposing raw price noise.

kartik: Edge-case: conflicting tenant override vs reconciler sticky_flag. Override must win but should be annotated as "manual_override" in reconciled_context with a TTL.

emily: Any infra config? knob list?

zoe: Remote config keys: reconciler.enabled, reconciler.mode (dark/canary/on), recon.smoothing.alpha, recon.median.window_ms, recon.hysteresis.count, recon.cooldown_ms, recon.cache.ttl.

kartik: Sounds good. Can you add a short RFC follow-up section documenting the reconciler state transitions and metrics thresholds? I'll link it to the main routing RFC.

zoe: Will do. PR incoming. Can everyone review by Wednesday? :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Dark-run started: job_id=rr-1798889999-1 status=running samples=0

qa-bot: Note: add a replay endpoint that accepts replay_id and forces policy-run with raw/reconciled snapshots for offline comparison.

zoe: Good call. Adding replay endpoint to the checklist. Closing thread for now.
